boards.title: 10 Late-Night Runs That Explain University of Detroit Mercy
boards.description: Ten under-21-safe food stops with currently published late hours, spanning the McNichols campus and Detroit destinations.

cards.title: The Loft
cards.subtitle: Student Union, McNichols Campus
cards.notes: Head to the Student Union grill on Monday through Thursday; confirm the semester calendar before going, as published hours are 11:30 a.m.–9:30 p.m.
cards.short_summary: An on-campus grill option with the latest published McNichols dining closing time.
cards.evidence_claim: Detroit Mercy lists Loft Grill semester hours through 9:30 p.m. Monday through Thursday.
cards.source_title: Where to Eat | University of Detroit Mercy
cards.access_notes: Published semester hours: Monday–Thursday, 11:30 a.m.–9:30 p.m.; Friday until 8 p.m. Confirm service during breaks.

cards.title: Tommy's
cards.subtitle: Whitty Student Fitness Center, McNichols Campus
cards.notes: Use this fitness-center food stop on a Monday through Thursday evening; the university posts fall/winter service through 9 p.m. and notes hours can change.
cards.short_summary: A campus food counter tied to the Whitty Student Fitness Center.
cards.evidence_claim: Detroit Mercy publishes Tommy's fall/winter hours until 9 p.m. Monday through Thursday and Sunday.
cards.source_title: Where to Eat | University of Detroit Mercy
cards.access_notes: Published fall/winter hours: Monday–Thursday 11 a.m.–9 p.m.; Sunday 6–9 p.m. The page says times changed with fitness-center hours.

cards.title: Caribbean Citchen
cards.subtitle: 10500 W McNichols Rd, Detroit
cards.notes: Plan an evening pickup or delivery from the McNichols Road location; its own site posts daily hours until 9 p.m. for the restaurant.
cards.short_summary: A McNichols Road restaurant whose official page lists daily dinner availability.
cards.evidence_claim: Caribbean Citchen lists its Detroit location at 10500 W McNichols Rd and daily hours of 10 a.m.–9 p.m.
cards.source_title: Caribbean Citchen | Caribbean Restaurant in Detroit, MI
cards.access_notes: Official site lists Monday–Sunday hours of 10 a.m.–9 p.m. and says delivery is available.

cards.title: Wendy's at Livernois + 8 Mile
cards.subtitle: 6333 W. 8 Mile Rd, Detroit
cards.notes: Use the restaurant or drive-thru for a late order; the official location page lists both services until 1 a.m. every day.
cards.short_summary: A nearby chain location with published 1 a.m. restaurant and drive-thru hours.
cards.evidence_claim: Wendy's lists restaurant and drive-thru hours of 6:30 a.m.–1 a.m. daily at 6333 W. 8 Mile Rd.
cards.source_title: Wendy's 6333 W. 8 Mile Rd. | Detroit, MI
cards.access_notes: Official location page lists restaurant and drive-thru service until 1 a.m. daily; holiday hours may vary.

cards.title: Wendy's on W. 7 Mile
cards.subtitle: 14401 W. 7 Mile, Detroit
cards.notes: Check the official locator before leaving, then use the 7 Mile location when a 24-hour food stop fits the plan.
cards.short_summary: A Detroit Wendy's location listed by its operator as open around the clock.
cards.evidence_claim: Wendy's Detroit location directory lists the 14401 W. 7 Mile restaurant as open 24 hours.
cards.access_notes: Wendy's official Detroit directory identifies 14401 W. 7 Mile as open 24 hours; check for holiday changes.

cards.title: Taco Bell on West McNichols
cards.subtitle: 15624 West McNichols, Detroit
cards.notes: Use the drive-thru when late service matters: the location page posts service until 4 a.m. Monday–Saturday and 3 a.m. Sunday.
cards.short_summary: A West McNichols drive-thru with the latest published hours on this board.
cards.evidence_claim: Taco Bell lists drive-thru hours until 4 a.m. Monday–Saturday and 3 a.m. Sunday at 15624 West McNichols.
cards.source_title: Taco Bell in Detroit, MI — 15624 West McNichols
cards.access_notes: Official page lists drive-thru hours: 9 a.m.–4 a.m. Monday–Saturday and 9 a.m.–3 a.m. Sunday; dine-in closes earlier.

cards.title: Taco Bell on Livernois
cards.subtitle: 14000 Livernois, Detroit
cards.notes: Use the official Detroit location list to check same-day status, then plan this Livernois drive-thru for its posted 3 a.m. closing time.
cards.short_summary: A Livernois Taco Bell listed as open until 3 a.m.
cards.evidence_claim: Taco Bell's official Detroit location directory lists the 14000 Livernois location as open until 3 a.m. and offering drive-thru service.
cards.source_title: Taco Bell Restaurants in Detroit, MI
cards.access_notes: Official Detroit directory lists 14000 Livernois as open until 3 a.m. and identifies drive-thru service; verify daily status before travel.

cards.title: Happy's Pizza on Woodward
cards.subtitle: 7451 Woodward Ave, Detroit
cards.notes: Order ahead or pick up at the Woodward Avenue restaurant; its location page posts midnight Monday–Thursday, 3 a.m. Friday–Saturday, and 1 a.m. Sunday.
cards.short_summary: A Woodward Avenue pizza stop with late published weekend hours.
cards.evidence_claim: Happy's Pizza lists its 7451 Woodward Ave Detroit location open until midnight Monday–Thursday, 3 a.m. Friday–Saturday, and 1 a.m. Sunday.
cards.access_notes: Official location page lists Mon–Thu 10 a.m.–12 a.m., Fri–Sat 10 a.m.–3 a.m., and Sun 9 a.m.–1 a.m.

cards.title: Toarmina's Pizza in Midtown
cards.subtitle: 4205 Cass Ave, Detroit
cards.notes: Choose this Cass Avenue pizza shop when midnight is too early; the official locations page lists closing as late as 2 a.m. Tuesday through Saturday.
cards.short_summary: A Midtown pizza location with published 1–2 a.m. closing times.
cards.evidence_claim: Toarmina's lists its Detroit Midtown location at 4205 Cass Ave, open until 1 a.m. Tuesday–Wednesday and 2 a.m. Thursday–Saturday.
cards.access_notes: Official listing: Sunday–Monday until midnight, Tuesday–Wednesday until 1 a.m., and Thursday–Saturday until 2 a.m.

cards.title: Sgt. Pepperoni's
cards.subtitle: 4140 Woodward Ave, Detroit
cards.notes: Visit the pizzeria inside the Garden Bowl for a late carry-out option; the venue posts service until 2 a.m. Tuesday through Saturday.
cards.short_summary: A Woodward Avenue pizzeria with published late carry-out hours.
cards.evidence_claim: The Majestic Theatre lists Sgt. Pepperoni's dine-in/carry-out hours until midnight Sunday–Monday and 2 a.m. Tuesday–Saturday.
cards.access_notes: Official page lists Sunday–Monday 11 a.m.–midnight and Tuesday–Saturday 11 a.m.–2 a.m. for dine-in/carry-out.
